improved_life_tap.name: Improved Life Tap
improved_life_tap.text: Increases the amount of Mana awarded by your Life Tap spell by 10%.

suppression.name: Suppression
suppression.text: Increases your chance to hit with all spells and attacks by 1% and reduces all threat you generate by 4%.

improved_corruption.name: Improved Corruption
improved_corruption.text: Reduces the casting time of your Corruption spell by 0.4 sec and increases the damage it deals by 2%.

malediction.name: Malediction
malediction.text: Increases all periodic damage done by your Warlock spells by 1%.

soul_harvesting.name: Soul Harvesting
soul_harvesting.text: You gain Soul Harvest for 10 sec if a victim is killed while afflicted with your Drain Soul. Soul Harvest allows your Mana to regenerate at 50% of normal speed while you are casting spells, and grants a 50% increase to your Mana regeneration.

improved_drains.name: Improved Drains
improved_drains.text: Increases the damage done or health drained by your Drain Life and Drain Soul spells by 2% per each of your other Affliction effects active on the target, up to a maximum increase of 6%. When your Drain Soul damages targets below 20% health, this bonus is tripled. Additionally, your Drain Life range is extended by 3 yards.

improved_bane_of_agony.name: Improved Bane of Agony
improved_bane_of_agony.text: Increases the damage done by your Bane of Agony by 5%.

fel_concentration.name: Fel Concentration
fel_concentration.text: Gives you a 23% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling or casting your Drain Life, Drain Mana, or Drain Soul spells.

amplify_curse.name: Amplify Curse
amplify_curse.text: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.

pandemic.name: Pandemic
pandemic.text: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, and Drain Hope spells by 33%.

malevolence.name: Malevolence
malevolence.text: Increases the critical effect chance of your Shadow spells by 1%.

nightfall.name: Nightfall
nightfall.text: Gives your Corruption, Drain Soul, and Drain Life spells a 2% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance after damaging the opponent. The Shadow Trance reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by 100%.

curse_of_exhaustion.name: Curse of Exhaustion
curse_of_exhaustion.text: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

siphon_life.name: Siphon Life
siphon_life.text: Transfers 15 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.

soul_siphon.name: Soul Siphon
soul_siphon.text: Increases the rate at which your Drain Life and Drain Soul deal damage by 17%, but reduces your healing from Drain Life by 10%.

shadow_mastery.name: Shadow Mastery
shadow_mastery.text: Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells by 1%.

drain_hope.name: Drain Hope
drain_hope.text: Drains all hope from the target, dealing 52 Shadow damage every 1 sec and increasing all other Shadow damage over time you deal to that target by 10%. Lasts 6 sec.

improved_health_funnel.name: Improved Health Funnel
improved_health_funnel.text: Increases the amount of health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by 20%, reduces its health cost by 15%, and reduces all threat your Health Funnel generates by 50%. Allows Health Funnel to be used regardless of your demon's health.

improved_imp.name: Improved Imp
improved_imp.text: Increases the damage of your Imp's Firebolt spell by 10% and the effect of its Fire Shield spell by 10%.

unholy_power.name: Unholy Power
unholy_power.text: Increases all damage done by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter pets by 2%.

demonic_aegis.name: Demonic Aegis
demonic_aegis.text: Increases the effectiveness of your Demon Skin and Demon Armor spells by 15%.

improved_voidwalker.name: Improved Voidwalker
improved_voidwalker.text: Increases the effectiveness of your Voidwalker's Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice, and Suffering spells by 10%.

fel_vitality.name: Fel Vitality
fel_vitality.text: Increases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by 5%, and increases your maximum Mana by 5%.

demonic_energies.name: Demonic Energies
demonic_energies.text: You heal your pet for 8% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 50% of the Mana you gain.

improved_sayaad.name: Improved Sayaad
improved_sayaad.text: Increases the effect of your Succubus' and Incubus' Lash of Pain and Soothing Kiss spells by 10%, and increases the duration of your Succubus' and Incubus' Seduction and Lesser Invisibility spells by 10%.

demonic_sacrifice.name: Demonic Sacrifice
demonic_sacrifice.text: When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 2 hrs. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned. Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%. Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec. Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%. Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.

master_summoner.name: Master Summoner
master_summoner.text: Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter Summoning spells by 2 sec and the Mana cost by 20%.

decimation.name: Decimation
decimation.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Soul Fire spell by 45%. When you cast Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain on an enemy below 35% health, they deal 3% increased damage, and for the next 10 sec your Soul Fire spell has its cast time reduced by 20% and costs no Soul Shards.

fel_domination.name: Fel Domination
fel_domination.text: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

demonic_brand.name: Demonic Brand
demonic_brand.text: Your Searing Pain generates 17% less threat and brands the target for 10 sec. Your pet's next 2 attacks against the target generate high threat and deal 39 to 42 Fire or Shadow damage based on the pet.

improved_felhunter.name: Improved Felhunter
improved_felhunter.text: Increases the Attack Power reduction of your Felhunter's Tainted Blood, the healing of its Devour Magic, and the detection level of its Paranoia by 10%, and reduces the cooldown of its Spell Lock by 2 sec.

soul_link.name: Soul Link
soul_link.text: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.

demonic_knowledge.name: Demonic Knowledge
demonic_knowledge.text: Increases your spell damage and healing by up to 33% of your level while you have a summoned Demon pet active.

master_demonologist.name: Master Demonologist
master_demonologist.text: Grants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active. Imp - Increases Fire damage done by 2%. Voidwalker - Reduces Physical damage taken by 2%. Succubus/Incubus - Increases Shadow damage done by 2%. Felhunter - Reduces Magic damage taken by 2%.

demonic_pact.name: Demonic Pact
demonic_pact.text: Your Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect.

destructive_reach.name: Destructive Reach
destructive_reach.text: Increases the range of your damaging spells by 10%.

improved_shadow_bolt.name: Improved Shadow Bolt
improved_shadow_bolt.text: Your Shadow Bolt critical strikes increase Shadow damage taken by the target from your attacks by 4% for 12 sec.

bane.name: Bane
bane.text: Reduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt, Immolate, and Incinerate spells by 0.1 sec and your Soul Fire spell by 0.4 sec.

cataclysm.name: Cataclysm
cataclysm.text: Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by 3%.

aftermath.name: Aftermath
aftermath.text: Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by 10% and your Conflagrate spell has a 20% chance to Daze the target, reducing the target's movement speed by 50% for 5 sec.

ruin.name: Ruin
ruin.text: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by 20%.

shadowburn.name: Shadowburn
shadowburn.text: Instantly blasts the target for 102 to 111 Shadow damage. If a non-trivial target dies within 8 sec of being hit with Shadowburn, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

intensity.name: Intensity
intensity.text: Gives you a 23% chance to resist interruption caused by damage while casting or channeling any Destruction spell.

agonizing_flames.name: Agonizing Flames
agonizing_flames.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by 3% and the damage done by all your Destruction spells by 3%.

conflagrate.name: Conflagrate
conflagrate.text: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 109 to 132 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.

pyroclasm.name: Pyroclasm
pyroclasm.text: Gives your Soul Fire spell a 13% chance to Stun the target for 3 sec, and your Rain of Fire and Hellfire spells a 13% chance over their duration to Stun targets they damage for 3 sec.

bane_of_havoc.name: Bane of Havoc
bane_of_havoc.text: Afflicts the target for 5 min, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to 1 target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

fire_and_brimstone.name: Fire and Brimstone
fire_and_brimstone.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Conflagrate spell by 8%.

shadow_and_flame.name: Shadow and Flame
shadow_and_flame.text: Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by 2% for 20 sec, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by 2% for 20 sec. In addition, Conflagrate has a 20% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a 20% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard.

incinerate.name: Incinerate
incinerate.text: Deals 125 to 140 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.
